events.strDescriptionEN:
Marc Márquez won the 2026 Malaysian MotoGP Grand Prix at the PETRONAS Sepang International Circuit. With a commanding performance, the Ducati Lenovo Team rider finished more than four seconds clear of the field.
The victory allows Márquez to take a giant leap toward the 2026 World Championship, establishing a 44-point lead over his primary title rival, Jorge Martín. Martín was forced to withdraw from the weekend due to a broken wrist suffered at the previous round in Australia. Sensationally, Pedro Acosta took second place following his Saturday Sprint race victory, while polesitter Álex Márquez completed the podium.
